cz: 经营家庭农田与运粮加工
有实际农民的家庭按劳动力经营矩形田地。选址不再围绕风车；原粮必须送到风车加工。内城覆盖后立即停耕，成熟作物可最后收取一次。
en: Farming households manage rectangular plots. Fields need no nearby mill; raw grain requires milling. Inner-city fields retire immediately with one final ripe harvest.

cz: 每株未成熟小麦可施肥一次，消耗1份肥料，收获原粮翻倍；生长期与收获月份保持原样。
en: Each unripe wheat plant accepts one fertilizer for double raw grain at harvest. Growth time and harvest months stay the same.

cz: 田块宽高须为1至12；每户上限须不小于起步面积且不超过144格。
en: Width and height must be 1–12. The area limit must cover the starting plot and cannot exceed 144 tiles.
